observations: Three photos show the same black lens, wrapped in bubble wrap, lying next to its lens hood and a second similar lens/cap.
Front barrel text reads 'AF-S NIKKOR' and '50mm 1.8G' clearly in photos 0, 1, and 2.
Rear barrel in photo 0/1 shows 'Nikon AF-S' markings and an aperture/distance scale window.
A finger is shown holding the lens in photo 1, giving scale and suggesting a real, physical item being photographed by the seller.
Front glass element appears clean and unscratched at this resolution, but no macro or back-lit shot is given to check for internal haze, fungus, or dust.
No shot of the rear mount contacts, serial number plate, or any accessory such as caps/box is clearly legible.
Watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI - OLAJIDE AMOS BISHOP' overlays all three images.

claims.claim: American used lens, clean and pure like new
claims.evidence: Cosmetic front-element cleanliness is visible in photos 0-2, but internal optical condition, origin ('American used'), and mechanical function cannot be confirmed from stills.
All three photos show the printed marking '50mm 1.8G' on the lens barrel (photo 0, 1, 2), not 60mm.

risks.risk: Autofocus motor and aperture blades may not function
risks.proof: A short video showing the lens autofocusing on a camera body and the aperture blades stopping down

risks.risk: Internal fungus, haze, or separation not visible at this photo resolution
risks.proof: A macro photo with a flashlight shone through the lens at an angle, or video under light

risks.risk: Mount or electronic contact damage affecting camera communication
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the rear bayonet mount and CPU contacts

risks.risk: Possible counterfeit or mismatched parts lens
risks.proof: Clear photo of the serial number plate matched against Nikon's format, plus a shot of the rear mount branding

risks.risk: Mismatch between seller's stated focal length (60mm) and the photographed lens (50mm) suggests possible listing error or wrong item being shipped
risks.proof: A fresh photo or video of the exact lens to be shipped, with focal length marking in frame alongside a timestamp or handwritten note
risks.if_unproven: priced as the 50mm f/1.8G shown in photos, not as any 60mm lens

proof_requests: Video of the lens mounted on a camera, showing autofocus and aperture operation
Close-up, well-lit photo of the serial number and rear mount contacts
Macro/back-lit shot through the lens to check for haze, fungus, or dust
Confirmation photo/video clarifying whether the item for sale is actually 50mm or 60mm, since the barrel reads 50mm
response.reason: The photos clearly identify a Nikon AF-S NIKKOR 50mm f/1.8G lens with legible markings, so it can be priced at worst case as an untested, cosmetically clean 50mm lens; the seller's '60mm' claim is contradicted by the visible text and should be priced according to what the photos actually show.
